$comment: Process verbs. Unary operators: drag one element onto a verb tool. This is the layer that separates us from Little Alchemy (A+B only) and teaches that process determines outcome.

verbs.name: Wait
verbs.blurb: Growth, weathering, ageing, decay. Some changes only need time.

verbs.name: Crush
verbs.blurb: Grinding, pressing, milling, churning. Force applied without heat.

verbs.name: Chill
verbs.blurb: Cold is not a technology, it is a night. Available from the start.

verbs.name: Heat
verbs.blurb: The first tool that makes new molecules rather than smaller pieces.

verbs.name: Cut
verbs.blurb: Separating one thing into parts. Needs an edge.

verbs.name: Ferment
verbs.blurb: Letting microbes do the work. Controlled, delicious rot.

verbs.name: Blow
verbs.blurb: Moving air. It sorts by weight, it dries, and it feeds a fire faster than the fire can draw breath on its own.

verbs.name: Smother
verbs.blurb: Take the air away. Combustion is a reaction with oxygen, and everything about it changes when the oxygen runs short.
